k: Owner of Peter's favorite Queens deli
st: Delmar makes Peter's usual sandwich and teases him about May, then Spider-Man saves him and Murph when his deli is blown apart.
At his new deli, Delmar sells Peter a headphone adapter for his Europe trip and asks if he can come along.

files.notes: Named on screen ('What's up, Mr. Delmar?', 'Delmar's Bodega'). His Far From Home scenes were cut and released as Peter's To-Do List, so Far From Home gets no step. Groups are his own shops, named on their signs (Delmar's Deli-Grocery in Homecoming, Delmar's II Deli & Grill in the short); the transcript calls the first 'Delmar's Bodega' and the news 'Delmar's Sandwiches'.

add.k: A Skrull newcomer who joins Gravik's rebels
st: Beto joins Gravik's rebels, helps infiltrate the Royal Navy, then leads a revolt to avenge Pagon and is killed by Gravik.

files.notes: Named on screen (G'iah: 'When's the last time you ate, Beto?'; Pagon: 'Why did you join the resistance, Beto?'). Group uses the app's name for Gravik's rebels. His part in the Ritson ambush (episode 4) is cited by the wiki but he is not clearly on screen there, so it is left out. op is Nick Fury as for Gravik; opp lists G'iah (secretly spying on him) and Talos (who aborts the Navy strike).

add.k: A Skrull rebel who takes an American's face
st: Brogan takes an American's face, carries a decoy bomb bag in Moscow, names the Daltons under torture, and is shot by Pagon.

files.notes: In episode 1 he is only labeled in captions; Gravik first says 'Brogan' in episode 2, so the name is staged. The American he copies (Martin Wallace) is never named in dialogue, so the step says 'an American'. Killed by Pagon in episode 2.

add.k: A Skrull operative in Gravik's rebels
st: Zirksu drives G'iah to the bomb deal, helps infiltrate the Royal Navy, then joins the revolt and dies on his own knife.

files.notes: Named on screen by Pagon ('Zirksu will drive you.'). Gravik twists Zirksu's own knife into him during the revolt in episode 5 (wiki).

add.k: A Skrull posing as an FXN news anchor
st: On air the anchor calls Moscow a false flag and warns of World War III, backs Gravik on the Council, and is shot by vigilantes.

files.notes: His name is never said; it is shown on screen as The Chris Stearns Show (his mug in episode 3, the studio desk in episode 6), so it is staged from episode 3. Group: the Skrull Council (said on screen; not yet in groups_in_app). He also works undercover at FXN News; the Council is how the story groups him. op/opp are loose: he never meets the heroes, but backs the war they fight.

k: A Skrull posing as the MI6 director
st: Falsworth's MI6 boss wants a raid on the bomb maker, until she shoots him, exposes Weatherby as a Skrull and makes him talk.

files.notes: 'Derrik' appears only as a caption label; 'Director Weatherby' is said by Falsworth in episode 5, so the name is staged. His file photo shows in episode 3 when Falsworth hunts the mole who leaked her butcher-shop site; Gravik credits 'our man on the inside' in episode 2. Group: served MI6 undercover, revealed as one of Gravik's moles in episode 5. His fate after Falsworth questions him is not shown: In custody.

add.k: The President of the United States
st: Ritson survives a Skrull ambush, nearly strikes Russia until Fury exposes his Rhodes as a Skrull, then vows to kill every alien.

files.notes: Addressed only as 'Mr. President' in episode 1; 'President Ritson' is first said in episode 2 (he appears there only in a photo). 'James' is never said. Only mentioned in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, so no step there.

add.k: A Skrull posing as the British prime minister
st: Lawton nominates Gravik as Skrull General, grills Colonel Rhodes at a London summit, then hears Gravik's Super Skrull plan.

files.notes: Called 'Madam Prime Minister' in dialogue; her full name is shown on a news graphic in episode 2 (the wiki's cropped image of it). Group: the Skrull Council (said on screen). Her fate after episode 3 is not shown: At large. op/opp are loose, as she never meets the heroes.

add.k: A Skrull scientist building Gravik's Super Skrull machine
st: Dr. Dalton tests Gravik's Super Skrull machine, until Falsworth raids her lab and shoots Victor when he takes her hostage.

files.notes: 'Dr. Dalton' is said in episode 2 (Pagon; Brogan names 'Dalton'); 'Rosa' and 'Dr. Rosa Dalton' are said in episode 5. Left in MI6's hands after the raid: In custody.

add.k: A Skrull posing as NATO's secretary general
st: Sergio calls the prime minister a traitor for backing Gravik, is struck silent, then submits and hears Gravik's war plan.

files.notes: 'Sergio' is said ('Seat yourself down, Sergio'); the full name Sergio Caspani is shown on a news graphic in episode 2. Side was a toss-up: he opposes Gravik at first but submits and joins the Council behind his war, so a Raft file. op is loose; he never meets the heroes.

add.k: A Skrull elder on the Skrull Council
st: Shirley refuses to back Gravik's coup on the Council, calls Talos to set up his meeting with Gravik, and later kills vigilantes.

files.notes: Only 'Shirley' is said (Gravik: 'Hello, Shirley'; Talos: 'Shirley, set up the meet'); 'Sagar' is never said or shown in what I could check. She stays undercover after quitting the Council's vote; group kept as the Skrull Council. Her fight with three hunters in episode 6 is from the wiki. Checker: tm now leaves the Council at episode 2, where she says 'I do not support your coup... And I do not submit' and walks out as Gravik takes over (wiki infobox: Skrull Council, formerly); she stays among the Skrull refugees (the app's 'Skrulls').

add.k: A Skrull rebel posing as a Moscow bomb maker
st: Poprishchin lies to Fury about his dirty bombs, unmasks Talos as a Skrull, fights him and is shot dead by Fury.

files.notes: Named on screen by Falsworth ('Vasily Poprishchin') and Pagon. Loyal to Gravik: he calls Talos a traitor to his people. Talos is posing as Agent Keller in the scene.

add.k: A Skrull scientist working on Gravik's Super Skrull machine
st: Victor helps test the Super Skrull machine, pulls a gun on Falsworth, then takes Rosa hostage and is shot dead by Falsworth.

files.notes: Brogan names the Daltons as 'some married couple' in episode 2; Victor gives his own name in episode 5 ('No, my name's Victor').

st: Fury holds Zachary at gunpoint to free Talos, Zachary asks if his dad will be killed, and his name turns out to be the abort code.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Zachary.', and the abort code word 'Zachary'). A boy with no group shown: Independent. The Skrull posing as his father is not in the app or the batch, so no tie for him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Peter buys his usual sandwich from Delmar, who teases him about May and tells him to stay in school. When a robber's blast cuts the deli in half, Spider-Man pulls Delmar and Murph out.
stages.whoA: A regular who saves him as Spider-Man
stages.whoB: The deli owner who makes his sandwiches

stages.title: Peter's To-Do List
stages.text: Before his class trip, Peter stops at Delmar's new deli for a headphone adapter and tries his Spanish. Delmar asks if he can come to Europe too.
stages.whoA: A regular off to Europe
stages.whoB: The deli owner who asks to come along

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah welcomes Beto to New Skrullos and feeds him Skrull food. Later she leaves him waiting in the car during Brogan's rescue, and he calls her a smart lady.
stages.whoA: The rebel who welcomes him
stages.whoB: A newcomer she brings into the rebels

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon readies Beto for the Royal Navy mission and tells him all faith is built on risk. When Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt to avenge him.
stages.whoA: The commander he avenges
stages.whoB: An operative he leads on missions

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto joins Gravik's rebels and serves on his missions. After Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt, calls him a monster, and Gravik kills him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: A soldier who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto and Zirksu infiltrate the Royal Navy together under Pagon. They join the revolt against Gravik, and both die in the fight.
stages.whoA: A fellow operative and rebel
stages.whoB: A fellow operative and rebel

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon oversees Brogan taking an American's face. He breaks Brogan out of the torture site, then shoots him in the woods.
stages.whoA: The commander who rescues, then kills him
stages.whoB: An operative he rescues, then kills

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Brogan carries a decoy bag in Gravik's Moscow bombing. Gravik rescues him from Falsworth, suspects he talked and has him killed.
stages.whoA: His leader, who has him killed
stages.whoB: An operative he suspects of talking

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah hands Brogan the empty decoy bag for the Moscow attack. She drives the car when the rebels rescue him and he is killed.
stages.whoA: The rebel who hands him the decoy bag
stages.whoB: A courier in the Moscow attack

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth takes over Brogan's interrogation, cuts off a finger to prove he is a Skrull and heats his blood. He tells her about Gravik's machine and the Daltons.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who tortures him
stages.whoB: A Skrull she tortures for names

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon sends Zirksu to drive G'iah to the bomb deal in Moscow.
stages.whoA: The rebel he drives to the bomb deal
stages.whoB: Her driver to the bomb deal

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon assigns Zirksu to drive G'iah, then leads him and Beto into the Royal Navy. After Gravik kills Pagon, Zirksu joins the revolt.
stages.whoA: The commander he follows
stages.whoB: An operative he leads

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Zirksu cheers Gravik's return and serves on his missions. In the revolt he tries to stab Gravik, who turns the knife on him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: An operative who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The anchor stands with Gravik when the Council makes him Skrull General. Gravik later shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he backs on the Council
stages.whoB: A Council member who backs him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Stearns and Lawton sit on the Skrull Council together. Both stand with Gravik and hear his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Council member
stages.whoB: A fellow Council member

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth briefs her MI6 boss on the Skrulls and talks him out of a raid. Later she shoots him, shows his staff he is a Skrull and makes him talk.
stages.whoA: The agent who exposes him
stages.whoB: Her MI6 boss, a Skrull mole

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Colonel Rhodes reports Fury AWOL, greets Ritson in England and pushes him to strike Russia. In the hospital, Fury proves Rhodes is a Skrull and kills him.
stages.whoA: His envoy Rhodes, secretly a Skrull
stages.whoB: The President he steers toward war

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury pulls Ritson from his wrecked car and later stops him striking Russia. When Ritson declares war on aliens, Fury scolds him and Ritson tells him to get the Skrulls off Earth.
stages.whoA: The spy who saves him, then scolds him
stages.whoB: The President he saves and argues with

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth holds Rhodes at gunpoint in front of Ritson and asks what he has to lose by waiting. Ritson calls off the strike.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who backs Fury
stages.whoB: The President she talks round

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik as Skrull General and leads the Council to submit to him. He then shows the Council his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general she puts in charge
stages.whoB: The Council member who makes him general

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: At a London summit, Lawton demands to know why Colonel Rhodes came instead of President Ritson. Rhodes dismisses the Russian photos of Fury and Hill.
stages.whoA: The U.S. envoy she grills
stages.whoB: The prime minister who grills him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The Daltons build and test Gravik's Super Skrull machine together. When Falsworth raids their lab, Victor takes Rosa hostage and is shot.
stages.whoA: Her partner, who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: His partner, whom he takes hostage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth raids Dr. Dalton's lab, makes her explain her research and burns the place. She shoots Victor when he takes Rosa hostage.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who raids her lab
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she captures

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon tells Dr. Dalton the Harvest was not found and hints Gravik is not always right. She tells him to leave.
stages.whoA: The rebel who brings bad news
stages.whoB: The scientist who sends him away

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Victor pulls a gun on Falsworth in his lab, then takes Rosa hostage outside. Falsworth shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who kills him
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon visits the Daltons' lab to report the Harvest is missing, before they test their machine.
stages.whoA: The rebel who reports to the lab
stages.whoB: A scientist at the Daltons' lab

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio trades insults with Gravik at the Council and calls the vote for him treason. A guard silences him, he submits, and Gravik shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he gives in to
stages.whoB: A Council member who gives in

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio calls Lawton a traitor for nominating Gravik. She tells him to sit down, and a guard chops his throat.
stages.whoA: The Council member he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Council member she silences

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley calls Talos after the Council vote and offers to help. She warns Gravik will kill him, but agrees to set up a meeting.
stages.whoA: The old friend she helps
stages.whoB: A Council elder who helps him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley chairs the Council meeting to judge Gravik for Moscow. She refuses to submit to his coup, and he lets her leave in peace.
stages.whoA: The rebel she will not follow
stages.whoB: The elder who defies him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik while Shirley is chairing the meeting. Shirley refuses to submit and walks out.
stages.whoA: The member who backs Gravik
stages.whoB: The elder who walks out

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury catches Poprishchin in two lies about his wife and the dirty bombs. When Poprishchin overpowers Talos, Fury shoots him.
stages.whoA: The spy who shoots him
stages.whoB: The bomb maker he shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Poprishchin unmasks the agent called Keller as Talos and calls him a traitor to his people. The two Skrulls fight in the gallery.
stages.whoA: The Skrull he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Skrull he fights for the bombs

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury holds Zachary at gunpoint so the Skrull posing as his father lets Talos go. Then he lets Zachary hug his dad.
stages.whoA: The intruder who holds him at gunpoint
stages.whoB: The boy he uses as leverage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Talos offers Zachary water to calm him. Zachary asks if Talos will kill his dad, and Talos says his dad just has to do the right thing.
stages.whoA: The intruder who tries to calm him
stages.whoB: The boy he tries to calm

dropped.why: Name only in the credits: the Ms. Marvel episode 2, 3 and 6 transcripts never say Zara (her friends Ruby and Humaira are named, she is not), and nothing shown names her. Checker re-tested: not said in the springfieldspringfield transcripts (no match for the name or spelling variants), and the wiki shows no on-screen name card or caption; drop stands.

Name only in the credits: no Secret Invasion transcript says Kreega (Gravik just orders 'Assemble the operatives' and 'send some of our people'), and nothing shown names her. Checker re-tested: not said in the springfieldspringfield transcripts (no match for the name or spelling variants), and the wiki shows no on-screen name card or caption; drop stands.

Name only in the credits: no Secret Invasion transcript says Steiner or Ruben (Rhodes says only 'Get me a mint'; Fury says 'your security detail'). The wiki cites episode 1 for the name, but I found nothing said or shown. Checker re-tested: not said in the springfieldspringfield transcripts (no match for the name or spelling variants), and the wiki shows no on-screen name card or caption; drop stands.

changes.why: She quits the Council in episode 2 ('I do not support your coup. I will not support your war. And I do not submit.') and leaves as Gravik takes it over; the rule moves a person out of a group when they quit. She remains a Skrull refugee, the app's 'Skrulls' group.

changes.was: Victor helps test the Super Skrull machine, pulls a gun on Falsworth, then takes Rosa hostage and is shot dead by her.
changes.now: Victor helps test the Super Skrull machine, pulls a gun on Falsworth, then takes Rosa hostage and is shot dead by Falsworth.
changes.why: 'shot dead by her' reads as Rosa shooting him; Falsworth shoots Victor in the head after he takes Rosa hostage.
